# ECN-2026-041 Change notice - Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P1, line P1-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01

Reason for change
- Background: A recent targeted inspection of equipment EQ-P1-L2-RR01 identified inconsistent clamp preload readings during mandrel setup checks. Investigation concluded that the current documented clamp bolt torque value and verification steps did not reflect the updated clamp assembly and tooling introduced during a prior retrofit. To eliminate variability in ring geometry and to reduce risk of clamp slippage during rolling, the mandrel clamp bolt torque specification is being standardized and propagated to operational and maintenance documentation.
- Objective: Update the assembly and maintenance practice to require a single, clear mandrel clamp bolt torque value for EQ-P1-L2-RR01, and align the mill maintenance procedure and standard operating procedures to that value. This change aims to improve repeatability of rolled ring dimensions and reduce rework caused by clamp underload or overconstraint.

Affected items
- Primary affected equipment: EQ-P1-L2-RR01, referred to in operator and maintenance tasks as the Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 located at Plant P1, line P1-L2.
- Documents to be revised: MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1, SOP-P1-L2-02, SOP-P1-L2-05. These documents contain maintenance schedules, torque tables, and startup checklists that reference mandrel clamp bolt torque for the subject mill.
- Tools and records: Torque wrench calibration entries, mandrel setup check sheets, and rolling run logs that reference clamp torque will be updated to record the standardized value.
- Consumables or parts: No change to part numbers is made by this notice. Existing clamp bolts and mating hardware remain in service unless inspection identifies damage.

Implementation
- New specification: The mandrel clamp bolt torque for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P1-L2-RR01) is 395 N·m. This value is to be used for initial assembly, pre-production setup, and any clamp retorque actions following maintenance or mandrel changeover.
- Procedure updates: MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1 will be revised to replace any prior torque references with the specified value and to add a verification step to confirm torque application with a calibrated torque wrench. SOP-P1-L2-02 and SOP-P1-L2-05 will be revised to include the torque value in startup and production checklists and to specify the record method for each rolling shift and each mandrel change.
- Application method: Apply torque in stages using the calibrated torque tool following the sequence described in the revised MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1. Verify final torque on each clamp bolt and record results on the updated mandrel setup check sheet. If final readings deviate from the specified value, follow the acceptance criteria and corrective action steps in MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.
- Calibration and tools: Only torque measuring tools with current calibration status shall be used to apply and verify clamp bolt torque. Calibration records must be available at the time of maintenance or setup verification and attached to the maintenance action record.
- Training and communication: Operators and maintenance personnel assigned to EQ-P1-L2-RR01 will complete a focused briefing covering the new torque specification, the rationale for the change, the verification steps, and the location of revised documents. The training will be documented in personnel training records and referenced when revisions to SOP-P1-L2-02 and SOP-P1-L2-05 are implemented.
- Examples of application scenarios:
  - During mandrel installation, the technician will torque the clamp bolts to the specified value and sign the mandrel setup check sheet. The rolling run will not commence until the setup sheet is complete and the torque verification has been recorded.
  - After a scheduled clamp maintenance action, the maintenance lead will torque each clamp bolt to the specified value, record the measurement, and attach the torque verification printout to the maintenance job record per MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1.
- Records to keep:
  - Updated mandrel setup check sheets for each mandrel installation, annotated with the applied torque and the name of the individual who performed the verification.
  - Torque wrench calibration certificates used for the application and verification, filed with maintenance records and accessible during audits.
  - Revision-controlled copies of MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1, SOP-P1-L2-02, and SOP-P1-L2-05 showing the change to the mandrel clamp bolt torque specification and the date of implementation.
  - Training acknowledgement records for all personnel briefed on the change.

Approvals
- Approval process: The engineering change will be approved by the equipment owner and maintenance manager. Approval signatures will be captured on the ECN approval sheet and stored in the document control system. Implementation of the change to MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1, SOP-P1-L2-02, and SOP-P1-L2-05 will not proceed until approvals are complete and calibration resources are confirmed.
- Post-implementation review: A verification review will be performed after initial implementation runs on EQ-P1-L2-RR01. The review will examine mandrel setup records, rolling run dimensional data, and any anomalies recorded since implementation. Findings will be documented and attached to the ECN approval record.
- Audit trail: All changes to MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1, SOP-P1-L2-02, and SOP-P1-L2-05 will be logged in the document control system with links to the approval documentation and training records.

Related documents
- MM-P1-L2-RR01-S1
- SOP-P1-L2-02
- SOP-P1-L2-05

Notes
- This change notice standardizes a single clamp bolt torque value for EQ-P1-L2-RR01 to reduce process variability. Follow-up actions include verification of tooling condition and a post-implementation dimensional check sequence to confirm the intended benefit. All records specified above are required to demonstrate compliance during internal and external reviews.
